name: University of Western Australia
summary: Perth university with Science, Commerce, Arts and Engineering degrees; Science and Biomedical Science start in February or July.

ib.text: UWA converts IB totals to an ATAR equivalent: 24 points is 70, 27 is 80, 30 is 85, 32 is 90, 35 is 94. English A needs SL 4 or HL 3; prerequisites are WA courses with published IB equivalents.

apply.via: UWA applicant portal (direct or via agent)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science
programmes.about: A three-year science degree with 29 majors, from agricultural science and anatomy to computer science, cybersecurity and data science, taught by UWA researchers.
programmes.ib: Minimum ATAR 70, which is 24 IB points on UWA's table; English A at SL 4 or HL 3 plus any prerequisites for your major.

needs.note: Grade 3 at HL; English B needs HL 5

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB total converted to an ATAR equivalent; the course page lists a minimum ATAR of 70.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Science: 29 majors across the traditional sciences and applied fields, intakes in February and July

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
programmes.about: An industry-developed engineering degree at UWA built on three core principles, leading to the Honours qualification.
programmes.ib: Minimum ATAR 80, which is 27 IB points on UWA's table; check the course page for maths and science prerequisites.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your IB total converted to an ATAR equivalent; the course page lists a minimum ATAR of 80.

flagshipSource.title: Engineering at UWA: a program developed with industry, built on three core principles

faculties.name: Science
faculties.line: Science and Biomedical Science: minimum ATAR 70, 24 IB points; both start in February or July.

faculties.name: Business School
faculties.line: Bachelor of Commerce: minimum ATAR 80, which is 27 IB points.

faculties.name: Arts
faculties.line: Bachelor of Arts: minimum ATAR 70, 24 IB points; 32 majors including languages and music.

faculties.name: Engineering
faculties.line: Engineering (Honours): minimum ATAR 80, which is 27 IB points.

notes: UWA maps its WA prerequisites to the IB: Maths Methods is Analysis and approaches SL 4 or Applications HL 3; Specialist Maths is Analysis and approaches HL 3; sciences are SL 4 or HL 3.
Some courses close earlier than others; the closing date is listed on the course page. UWA publishes no general international closing date.
The Bachelor of Science page body says minimum ATAR 70, but its search-result text says 80; ask UWA which applies.
